meta.name: Superman Man of Tomorrow
meta.description: It’s the dawn of a new age of heroes, and Metropolis has just met its first. But as Daily Planet intern Clark Kent – working alongside reporter Lois Lane – secretly wields his alien powers of flight, super-strength and x-ray vision in the battle for good, there’s even greater trouble on the horizon.
meta.slogan: Before he was the Man of Steel, he was the Man of Tomorrow.
